flora: Mature Ginkgo tree (distinct fan-shaped leaves with deep central notches, arranged in clusters)
Fleshy, plum-like ginkgo seeds (hanging on thin stalks)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; fan leaves should be rendered with clear, stylized parallel veins and thick, rounded leaf margins; the canopy should have a bold, graphical silhouette; avoid chaotic, messy leaf scattering.

visual_logic.composition: A mid-angle, wide shot of an ancient Ginkgo tree standing at the edge of a river clearing. Its dense canopy displays a transition of deep greens and light, pale ochre tones, shedding a small trail of fan leaves.
visual_logic.ground: Rich silt brown bank leading down to calm water, partially covered in a decorative layer of fallen fan-shaped leaves.
visual_logic.lighting: SUNNY_EXPOSED_CINEMATIC; bright afternoon sun casting long, clear graphical shadows of the fan leaves across the open clearing.
